name: Matěj Samler
title: Staff Software Engineer
tagline: I build on Power Platform from a developer's seat, not the maker's.
bioShort: Staff Software Engineer at NETWORG. I work on Power Platform extensibility - plugins, PCFs, and the ALM tooling around them - and I'm currently going deep on agentic engineering for the platform.
bioLong: I'm a Staff Software Engineer at NETWORG with hands-on experience across the whole Power Platform - plugins, Power Automate, PCFs, Power Apps. Whatever corner of the platform a problem lives in, I've usually been there.

My focus is pro development: building robust, extensible solutions from a developer's perspective rather than clicking through the maker experience. In practice that means source control, real build systems, testable code, and a fast local inner loop - the things that let a Power Platform team work like a software team.

Lately I've been going deep on the agentic side of the platform: designing AI-driven, agent-based approaches to extend what Power Platform can do, and working out how you validate behaviour when an agent is the one changing your code.

topics: Power Platform ALM: source control, build systems and CI/CD
The developer inner loop - local builds, early bound types, unit testing plugins and PCF
Testing and validating behaviour when AI changes your code
Integrations: Custom Connectors, Dataflows and Virtual Tables
PCF and Power Apps Component Framework
Power FX SDK and low-code plugins
